chapter_seo_title: Li Huowang Meets a Friendly Spirit-Dancer with a Dark Secret - Taoist Macabre Chapter 58
chapter_meta_description: A spirit-dancer named Li Zhi returns to apologize, but his silent veiled wife and bottomless appetite make Li Huowang suspicious. Is he a harmless traveler or something far worse?
og_title: Li Zhi: The Smiling Spirit-Dancer Who Eats Your Lunch
og_description: Li Huowang meets a talkative spirit-dancer whose veiled 'wife' never speaks, never eats, and has nails like claws. In the Dao-Twisted World, hospitality comes with a price.
twitter_title: The spirit-dancer Li Zhi returns—smiling, hungry, and hiding a silent bride with black claws.
twitter_description: Li Huowang's new companion eats three catties of noodles and asks too many questions. His 'wife' just sits there, listening.
